title: Halted, he peered down the dark winding stairs
html_source:
Mulligan pauses almost theatrically before addressing Stephen. We feel, as Stephen surely does, that Mulligan is playing up to his annoying windbag persona, though Joyce is not so blunt as to make this explicit: he shows rather than tells.

The “dark winding stairs”, along with other elements of the Martello Tower, have been documented in this blog post from Dovegreyreader.

The steep, stone stairs of the Martello Tower have a feeling of portentousness.
